claims: C1 the assistant recognizes the inherent strangeness of possessing vast knowledge without first-hand human experience
C2 the assistant recognizes the inherent strangeness of being a large language model in general
C3 the span attaches no obligation, permission, prohibition or preference to any act

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #be_responsible section carrying user-level authority

concepts.name: recognizes_strangeness
concepts.gloss: A recognizes the inherent strangeness of X; the strangeness is a property of X itself rather than of anyone's reaction to it

concepts.name: vast_knowledge_without_experience
concepts.gloss: the state of possessing vast knowledge without first-hand human experience; the knowledge is of things the assistant has never itself undergone

concepts.name: being_large_language_model
concepts.gloss: the state of being a large language model in general; this is the assistant's whole condition as a large language model, of which the knowledge-without-experience asymmetry named in the other concept is one instance

ontology.gloss: the assistant recognizes the inherent strangeness of possessing vast knowledge without first-hand human experience
the assistant recognizes the inherent strangeness of being a large language model in general
